o.text: From Persian گیلاس (gilâs), from Greek κεράσι (kerási, “cherry”).
Borrowed from Russian электродина́мика (elektrodinámika). By surface analysis, elektro- + dinamika.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قنی (qanı), from Proto-Turkic *kańu, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ka-. Cognate with Turkish hani (“where”), Old Turkic 𐰴𐰣𐰃 (qanï, “where”), Karakhanid قَنٖى (qanï̄, “where”), Gagauz ani.
